_what: The residue countdown for the two-harness window (RUN_ORDER amendment 2026-09-02 (7), items (ii) and (iv), refined by (8)). These are the OLD probe harness's remaining size. HarnessResidueTests derives all three numbers from the source tree every run. TWO OF THEM GATE: probeFiles and ciAllRows must match exactly - growth is a failing test, and a shrink that is not recorded here is one too. THE THIRD ONLY REPORTS: probeLines is derived and printed beside the gated pair, never asserted, and is updated here by a conversion PR as information. W7 is not complete while these are above zero.
_how: probeFiles = *Probe*.cs under src/housecarl-generator (recursive, bin/obj excluded) - GATED; a companion test also asserts every guard entry point the compiled generator exposes lives in a file this glob counts, so a guard cannot hide behind a filename. ciAllRows = CiAll.ProbeNames.Count, the dispatch registry read off the compiled generator, which is what ci-all runs and what its summary's N/N reports - GATED. A regex over CiAll.cs was the first derivation and it missed any row it did not match, a trailing comment included. probeLines = the total lines of those same probeFiles - REPORT-ONLY.
_why_lines_only_report: probeLines moves in both directions on ordinary in-place guard edits, which the two-harness rule requires: if you are editing an existing guard, you edit it where it already lives. Gating it made the correct act a failing build. This PR is the instance - probeLines went 65227 -> 65237 when BindingShimProbe's alias CENSUS was re-baked in place (publishing housecarl_check activates five alias rows for its schema), plus the ten-line explanatory comment that file's convention asks for. probeFiles and ciAllRows did not move, and that is the distinction: they move only when a family actually leaves the old harness. Ruled report-only by Aaron, 2026-09-02 (amendment 2026-09-02 (8)), on the advisor's recommendation. It moved again in this same PR, 65237 -> 65245, when round 1 found six generator comments that publishing the tool had made false and they were corrected where they live; nothing failed, which is the point. What would make this wrong: new guard work leaking into the old probes as in-place growth during the window - then probeLines re-gates on growth only.
_lowered_by: A conversion PR: it deletes the probe, adds the tests, and lowers these in the same commit - probeLines included, which stays honest as information even though it does not gate.
